firm_data.firm_description: Gallo Vitucci Klar LLP is a full service litigation firm consisting of more than 130 attorneys and having an extensive practice dedicated to providing experienced and innovative legal services to both long-term and new clients. From the beginning, we have placed a premium on legal expertise, experience and strong client commitment.
notable_facts: One-third of the firm's attorneys have been awarded the distinction of Super Lawyers.
The firm has offices in New York and New Jersey.

email.subject: AI for Gallo Vitucci Klar LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Melissa,

With one-third of your 130 attorneys recognized as Super Lawyers, Gallo Vitucci Klar is exactly the kind of high-performing firm we built Lucio for. Managing that level of expertise across complex litigation and insurance coverage work demands tools that scale without compromise.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding into New York. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how we're helping similar firms compete without adding headcount.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
